purpose: Teach: カーペット/バイブル/粥/開封/迷路/曲がる/下校/高血圧

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、カーペット、絶対、買ったよ
lines.en: Sho, I actually bought a brand new carpet. I'm serious.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Slight lift of pride in the announcement. Calm steady pace. Speaking to a child she adores—simple, direct, no performance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくの絵本、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、バイブル、絶対、なんだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, your picture books are like my Bible. I'm totally serious.
lines.style: Earnest, unguarded enthusiasm. Spoken with the unselfconscious admiration a 6-year-old has for someone he looks up to. Quick pace, genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お粥、絶対、翔くんに、絶対、作ってあげる
lines.en: I'm going to make you porridge, Sho. You know I mean it.
lines.style: Tender, protective tone. Speaks as though making porridge for him is a small promise she's making. Soft, unhurried pace. The voice of someone taking care of someone she loves.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくの手紙、絶対、開封、絶対、してくれた?本気で
lines.en: Mei-sis, did you really open that letter I gave you? I need to know.
lines.style: Quiet intensity underneath. Child's directness mixed with real concern. Pace slows on the question. Not demanding, but genuinely asking for reassurance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 公園の、本気で、絶対、迷路、絶対、翔くんと、絶対、一緒に、絶対、入りたいわ
lines.en: I want to go through the park maze with you, Sho. Really.
lines.style: Animated but genuine. Warmth with an undertone of wanting to share something with him. Slightly breathier on 'really'—like she's offering something that matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、自転車、絶対、左に、絶対、曲がるの、絶対、上手だよね
lines.en: You're really good at turning your bike left, Mei-sis. You know that, right?
lines.style: Genuine admiration, no irony. Child's simple observation delivered with sincerity. Slight rise at the end—asking for confirmation of something he's noticed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 下校途中の、本気で、絶対、翔くん、絶対、メイ姉さんの、絶対、お店に、絶対、寄って
lines.en: Stop by my place on your way home from school, okay Sho?
lines.style: Warm, natural invitation. Speaks like it's a small standing offer, something she'd like him to do. Gentle, unhurried. The tone of an older sister who wants him around.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、高血圧、絶対、なんだ、絶対、心配だよね、メイ姉さん
lines.en: Grandpa has high blood pressure, doesn't he? That worries me. Does it worry you too?
lines.style: Quiet concern layered underneath. Speaking from genuine worry, not seeking reassurance but checking in with someone he trusts. Slower pace. Soft, genuine.
